text:
I can set this up, but I need your OK on a few things first. I haven't changed anything yet.

**Ask first:**

1. **Forge token on this laptop.** Setup would copy the `gh` token for `acme-dev` into the macOS keychain. That makes this laptop hold a token that can read `acme/webapp` and report commit status or register runners. Is that OK?
2. **Admin rights.** Runner mode needs an admin of `acme/webapp`, since registering runners requires Administration: write. Is `acme-dev` an admin there? If not, I can use checks mode, which posts commit statuses without runners.
3. **Memory budget.** Defaults would be 8 GiB all the time and 16 GiB while plugged in. You said you don't want it hogging memory, so I'd suggest 4 GiB everyday and 16 GiB on AC. On battery, I'd suggest "off" so it never runs unplugged. Which do you want?
4. **Workflow edits.** Do you have a local checkout of `acme/webapp`? If not, I'd clone it to a durable location you choose. I'd run `migrate` as a report only and show you the diff. I won't write or commit anything without your go-ahead.

**Commands I'd run after you agree:**

```sh
# 1. Check current state and admin rights
command -v tentmaker || echo "not installed"
gh auth status
gh api repos/acme/webapp --jq '.permissions.admin'

# 2. Install the binary only
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/baney75/tentmaker/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --no-setup

# 3. Set up (no TTY, so flags and --yes; token comes from gh for the sudo user)
sudo tentmaker setup --yes --json --repo acme/webapp --memory 4GiB --boost-memory 16GiB --on-battery off

# 4. Verify
tentmaker doctor --json
tentmaker budget --json
tentmaker pool --json

# 5. Check which workflows would change (report only, no writes)
tentmaker migrate CHECKOUT_PATH --json
```

If `doctor` reports problems, I'll apply each listed fix and rerun it. If it still fails after two tries, I'll stop and report back.

Once you've reviewed the migrate report, I'll ask before running `tentmaker migrate CHECKOUT_PATH --write --json`. After that, you'd review the diff, and I'd only commit on a branch and open a PR if you say so.

Let me know your answers to the four questions, and the path to your checkout if you have one.
